responsibility: This header declares the alists address-list abstraction used in the mc-boot runtime. It defines the opaque alist handle and callback type and exports the operations for creating, destroying, appending, indexing, searching, deduplicating, removing, iterating, and duplicating lists of ADDRESS values.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the interface half of the Galists pair, keeping the alist representation opaque and exporting the callback and list-operation declarations, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/Galists.cc defines the underlying node structure and implements the address-list behavior.
